author: bardic-inspiration
name: Excavator's Tools
summary: A folding spade, pry bar, plumb line, and shoring pegs for digging, tunnelling, and propping up what you dig.
description: Diggers, sappers, and tomb-robbers prize these sturdy kits. Each one has a pick head, a collapsing spade, and a coil of knotted line, and the best are cared for like family heirlooms.

tool.utilize: Shore up a tunnel or trench against collapse (DC 15), or judge whether a dig is safe by its sound and dust (DC 15)
